WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    s.insurstat,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) as distinct_zones
  FROM scanconservation sc
  JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.insurstat
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(step1.distinct_zones) as total_sum
  FROM step1
)
SELECT 
  step1.insurstat,
  step1.distinct_zones,
  CAST(step1.distinct_zones AS REAL) / step2.total_sum as division_result
FROM step1
CROSS JOIN step2
WHERE step2.total_sum IS NOT NULL
